title: Chaos on surfaces and beyond: a new notion of dynamical hyperbolicity
summary: We present some developments in the study of chaotic dynamics following the solution of a conjecture of Newhouse on the measures maximizing the entropy of smooth surface diffeomorphisms. We focus on \emph{strong positive recurrence}, a generalization of the classical Anosov-Smale theory of uniform hyperbolicity introduced in a joint work with Sylvain Crovisier and Omri Sarig.
